check_markov_matrix: check if a given 2D matrix is a valid Markov matrix where each row sums to 1
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function with a list of matrices to verify Markov property
validate_row_sums: validate that all rows in a matrix sum to exactly 1 using f_gold
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that checks if each row of a matrix sums to 1
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function logic for detecting non-Markov matrices by row sum comparison
